description: Deep in Ethiopia’s Danakil Depression, Dallol Volcano erupts with a kaleidoscope of colors—orange, yellow, and green mineral terraces steaming under a scorching sun. Learn how chemistry paints this surreal landscape. Follow us for more explosive earth wonders.
